# schema-compat

> Detect breaking changes between two JSON Schema versions of an event under backward, forward or full compatibility, with JSON pointer paths Python package `trysac-schema-compat`, import name `schema_compat`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
